evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Provide meaningful fixture and compiler assertion coverage for every supported safe-output type.
intent.acceptance: Partial facet: statically registered safe-output tools with a canonical safe-outputs schema key have a structurally valid standalone pkg/cli/workflows/test-*.md declaration at the same immutable revision. Runtime exercise, imported-only fixtures, dynamic tools and Go compiler assertions remain separate.

evidence.opportunity: Static safe_outputs_tools.json tool names mapped from underscores to schema hyphens and intersected with canonical safe-outputs properties.
filters: Validate actual standalone fixture frontmatter against the same-revision Draft-7 main schema.
Only direct safe-outputs keys in valid test-*.md fixtures supply declaration coverage.
Configuration-only keys and tools outside the canonical schema intersection do not create false fixture gaps.
Fixture availability is repository state, not fresh delivery, compiler acceptance or workflow causation.
evidence.collection: Replay digest-checked immutable fixture/schema/registry facts; independent validation denies remote schema retrieval.

model.architecture: Independent same-revision structural validation and registered-type declaration coverage.
model.recommendation: Review native fixture gaps separately from compiler assertions and runtime exercise.
